# viettelcloud_private_ip (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud private IP by ID or by address with optional subnet, VPC, and region criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup a private IP by ID
data "viettelcloud_private_ip" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Lookup a private IP by address and a human-readable network hierarchy
data "viettelcloud_private_ip" "by_network_hierarchy" {
  ip_address  = "10.0.1.10"
  vpc_name    = "my-vpc"
  subnet_cidr = "10.0.1.0/24"
}

# Lookup a private IP by address and stable parent IDs
data "viettelcloud_private_ip" "by_parent_ids" {
  ip_address = "10.0.1.10"
  subnet_id  = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  vpc_id     = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Private IP ID (UUID). Exactly one private IP must match.
- `ip_address` (String) Private IP address to filter by.
- `region` (String) Region name where the private IP resides to filter by.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) CIDR of the subnet containing the private IP to filter by.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID (UUID) containing the private IP to filter by.
- `subnet_name` (String) Name of the subnet containing the private IP to filter by.
- `vpc_cidr` (String) Lookup-only CIDR of the VPC containing the private IP.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (UUID) containing the private IP to filter by.
- `vpc_name` (String) Name of the VPC containing the private IP to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) CIDRs currently allowed by the platform for this private IP.
- `allowed_vip_ids` (Set of String) Private IP IDs currently allowed as VIPs.
- `attached_vips` (Attributes Set) Private IPs attached as allowed VIPs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attached_vips))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the private IP was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description of the private IP.
- `device_owner` (String) Device owner classification assigned by the platform.
- `display_name` (String) Display name assigned by the platform.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address assigned to the private IP.
- `port_security` (Boolean) Whether port security is enabled.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the attached server, when present.
- `server_name` (String) Name of the attached server, when present.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the private IP was last updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--attached_vips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attached_vips`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Allowed VIP private IP ID (UUID).
- `ip_address` (String) Allowed VIP address.
